INFO.name: QUERY
INFO.value: SELECT TOP 200 access_url, dataproduct_subtype, t_min, lsst_band, s_ra, s_dec FROM ivoa.ObsCore WHERE dataproduct_type = 'image' AND obs_collection = 'LSST.DP1' AND dataproduct_subtype = 'lsst.visit_image' AND CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', 59.28107, -48.98508), s_region) = 1

FIELD.name: s_ra
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Central Spatial Position in ICRS; Right ascension

FIELD.name: s_dec
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Central Spatial Position in ICRS; Declination
